history.title: טולי והים שבא והולך
history.summary: Tuli, a small sea turtle on the Tel Aviv beach, notices the sea coming and going. Grandma turtle explains that the Moon's gentle pull makes the tides; here the sea moves only a turtle's step, in far places it climbs a giant staircase. Refrain: ששש... הים בא. ששש... הים הולך. Music: Debussy, Clair de lune.

history.title: Mira and the Magnet That Loved Metal
history.summary: Mira, four, is given a little red horseshoe magnet from her grandfather's toolbox. It grabs the spoon and the nail but ignores wood, paper, plastic and glass, and she is afraid it is broken; sorting a click pile and a quiet pile she finds the real rule. The true fact: a magnet only pulls things with iron inside (iron, steel, nickel, cobalt), which is why the aluminium can and the copper coin stay put even though they are metal. Refrain: Click! The magnet grabs. Shhh. The magnet lets go. No music.

options.title: קיפי לומדת להתרווח
options.summary: A little hedgehog named Kipi is scared of every rustling sound and curls into a tight ball, until a wise old tortoise helps her learn which sounds are safe, and she finally uncurls to make a friend.

options.title: הלב הקטן של תום
options.summary: Before bed, Tom presses his hand to his chest and feels his heart racing from play, then notices it grow slow and calm as he breathes and settles into sleep.

options.title: פעמוני הזהב של נוגה
options.summary: Noga discovers a row of bells of different sizes in Grandpa's attic and learns that big bells sing low notes while tiny bells sing high ones, so she rings them into a soft bedtime tune.
options.music: Tchaikovsky – Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy (celesta bells)

options.title: הגמל שצף בים המלח
options.summary: A curious young camel named Sahar visits the Dead Sea for the first time, worried she'll sink, but discovers the extra-salty water gently holds her up so she floats without even trying.

options.title: השמיכה שיש בה מקום לשניים
options.summary: Danny doesn't want to share his favorite blanket with his little sister at story time, but discovers that snuggling under it together makes it warmer and cozier for them both.
